text:
```yaml
name: Check System Prompts

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-system-prompts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run checks
      run: |
        pytest tests/check_system_prompts.py
```
